llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define a `linking` object with `prefixes` matching the requested prefix.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: A `linking` object is defined with `prefixes: ['myapp://']` and passed to the Navigation component.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set `linking` with 'profile/:userId'` on the Profile screen configuration.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The Profile screen configuration includes `linking: { path: 'profile/:userId' }` inside the static navigator definition.
